text:
carla_support: escalated from Acme  structured-output mode intermittently returns invalid JSON under load. They see duplicated closing braces or concatenated object fragments.

devon: can you paste the exact streaming payload and logs? We need root-level fragments.

carla_support: paste from customer log:
```
{"id":"resp_1","content":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"a\"}]"
```
...then later in the same stream:
```
{"id":"resp_2","content":"\",\"meta\":{\"trace\":\"ok\"}}]}}"
```
This ends up concatenated into a single line and is unparsable.

carla_support: repro curl they used:
```
curl -sS -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Prefer: structured-output=1" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3.8b","stream":true,"input":"list items"}'
```

devon: suspect session affinity change in recent rollout (2026-02-12)  shard handoff may not flush the session-keystore, causing two shards to stream fragments to the same connection. Putting this on eng-runtime.

liam: config hash for serving-pool-3 is f2e9a1d. Rollout notes attached in ticket ENG-2026-310.

maya: immediate mitigation for customer: ask them to disable streaming structured output or set Prefer: structured-output=0 and use a non-streaming call. Also we can evict ephemeral keys for their workspace.

maya: admin evict command:
```
/admin evict-session-cache --customer acme-corp --prefix "resp_"
```

sre-bot: ALERT: spike in 500/502 from serving-pool-3 18:02:00-18:08:00 UTC  correlated with high concurrency from acme-corp test runs.

devon: repro plan  run internal loadtest (scripts/loadtest/streaming_json_race.sh) with 1000 concurrent streams for 60s, instrument handoff path and enable trace ids.

billing: customer also reports unexpected token charges due to automatic retries. Escalating to billing-team; cc @billing-ops. Please attach request IDs from repro to bill team.

carla_support: i've created a support ticket (SUP-1129) and opened ENG-2026-310. Assigned to eng-runtime + devon. Next steps: eng to reproduce with loadtest and confirm cache flush fix. Will update customer with workaround.

devon: logging todo: add per-connection stream id in logs and a checksum of emitted frames so we can detect boundary collisions post-mortem.

maya: noted. i'll ping customer with the temporary workaround and ETA.

carla_support: thanks  marking as high priority. Keep updates here.
